say:4:1620778102:1.text: How should I put it? It's only been one night...
say:4:1620778102:1.source_cn: 该怎么说呢，仅仅是过了一晚上的时间……

say:5:1620778103:1.text: But everyone, and I mean everyone, no longer cares about chaos magic.
say:5:1620778103:1.source_cn: 所有人，我是说所有人！一点都不关心混沌魔法的事了！
say:5:1620778103:1.male: But everyone, and I mean everyone, no longer cares about chaos magic.
say:5:1620778103:1.female: But everyone, and I mean everyone, no longer cares about chaos magic.

say:6:1620778104:1.text: Apparently, Clarence stayed up all night and figured out how chaos magic actually works. He wrote up a ridiculously complex formula, and everyone believes it's right.
say:6:1620778104:1.source_cn: 听说是克莱尔昨天夜里研究出了混沌魔法的原理，得出了一个...

say:7:1620778105:1.text: Also, there were way too many people gossiping last night. Now the whole alchemy classroom situation is spreading...
say:7:1620778105:1.source_cn: 而且，可能是昨天晚上聚集的人过于多了，炼金术课上关于爱...

say:9:1620778107:1.source_cn: 蕾娜甚至跟我说，她要研究用于猫头鹰之间的爱情魔药！

say:11:1620778109:1.text: Ah, of course... Once in a while, the students  collectively get obssessed with a random research topic.
say:11:1620778109:1.source_cn: 原来如此……几年一度的爱情魔药研究潮又一次开始了啊。

say:12:1620778110:1.text: The last time this happened, I recall no shortage of brilliant new discoveries.
say:12:1620778110:1.source_cn: 我记得上一次的时候，发生了很多惊险的故事，也有很多浪漫...

say:13:1620778111:1.text: Based on my experience, I'll give it three days at most, and a new trend will take its place.
say:13:1620778111:1.source_cn: 不过根据我的经验，最多三天，这场新的潮流又会被更新的潮...

say:14:1620778112:1.text: I suppose that's what makes the Lyceum so lively and charming.
say:14:1620778112:1.source_cn: 这就是莱希拉姆的生机与魅力所在啊。
